children: Lantheus Holdings voluntarily withdrew and resubmitted its HSR pre-merger notification, restarting a new 30-day waiting period that now expires Oct. 21, 2026.
Parent withdrew the HSR filing on Sept. 17 to give the FTC more time, then refiled on Sept. 21, restarting the 30-day waiting period.
The new HSR waiting period expires Oct. 21, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET unless ended earlier or extended by an FTC request.
The parties say withdrawal/refiling is routine and continue to cooperate with the FTC while targeting closing in H1 2027, subject to approvals and stockholder vote.
Company filed a definitive proxy on Sept. 8, 2026; investors are urged to read the proxy and related SEC filings for details.
